mentions.name: RevMozi
mentions.description: This product helps non-marketers run both inbound and outbound go-to-market (GTM), codifying marketing principles with funnels and marketing automation. It is currently in beta, with the team dogfooding the product ahead of coming out of beta next month.
mentions.problem: Founders coming from tech backgrounds know nothing about marketing; startup founders kept describing GTM as a tangential problem, which boils down to marketing for non-marketers.
mentions.audience: Non-marketers, particularly startup founders, who need to run go-to-market themselves
mentions.source_excerpt: So we pivoted to RevMozi(https://revmozi.com/), which helps non-marketers do both inbound and outbound GTM.

evidence.value: So we pivoted to RevMozi(https://revmozi.com/), which helps non-marketers do both inbound and outbound GTM.
